units.Y: nuclei per baryon; number fluence = mass_fluence / atomic_mass_unit * Y
units.kinetic_MeV_per_u: nonrelativistic energy per baryonic atomic-mass unit; multiply by A for energy per projectile

decay_scope: Same one-body beta rates as the saved network, evolved separately in every velocity packet using proper flight time. Nuclear daughter keeps parent bulk velocity; beta recoil broadening and charged decay-particle transport are separate. In-flight decay Q is not added to the ion kinetic waveform.

endpoint.pressure_scope: Global residual internal energy envelope only; individual shell acceleration is unresolved. B2 has a separately saved eight-time sensitivity.

exact_nodal.scope: Each cell supplies half its mass and isotope inventory to each bounding node; exact saved nodal kinetic energy. Node0 has no finite ballistic arrival. Discrete impulses have no unique instantaneous power.

smooth.model: uniform dm/dv within each cell; original cell isotope composition retained; finite initial radius included

spectral_packets.quadrature: 8-point Gauss-Legendre in velocity per cell, mass-conserving

prompt.scope: Grey radiation integral, no photon spectrum. Radial-ray delay; angular source-size smearing is not resolved.

electron_bookkeeping.scope: Electron kinetic energy is a component-scale diagnostic, not an extra addition to hydrodynamic K. Actual ion charge and sheath potential require plasma transport. Recombination radiation or carried ionization energy must not be counted twice.
